summary: This 8-K by SLM Student Loan Trust 2006-7, a student loan asset-backed securities trust, reports that an affiliate of the depositor (Navient Funding) intends to submit hold orders and buy bids at a specified rate (SOFR+1.50%) in upcoming auctions for two classes of auction-rate notes (A-6B and A-6C). The affiliate already holds all of the A-6B notes and nearly all A-6C notes. Although the filings describe auction mechanics reminiscent of a tender or buyback, this is a routine operational update for a structured finance vehicle, not a transformative special situation. There is no acquisition or change of control, only the depositor's affiliate maintaining its position. Watch for potential rate-setting or liquidity shifts; no risk-arb opportunity.
